sources.title: G4.5 Common Runtime Ownership Architecture v0.1
G4.5 C0 Implementation Plan v0.1 - Runtime Interaction Consolidation

accepted_claims: common runtime ownership across Windows Android Web
third-plus contact deviation is accepted non-blocking
Pending first plus second becomes ViewportGesture
Ink-locked first plus later second becomes independent Ink
MultiInk and GesturePriority code seams exist

trusted_statements: C0 is a behavior-preserving ownership extraction, not a redesign of G4.4 interaction semantics.
AutoIntent remains the current default and blocking product guarantee.
MultiInk and GesturePriority remain implemented but deferred non-blocking modes.
The accepted third-plus-contact during active two-contact ViewportGesture finding remains unchanged in C0.
Existing MultiContactCoordinator and TwoFingerViewportGesture semantics are preserved and composed by new runtime-owned orchestration.
InkPlaygroundHost must stop owning contact arbitration caches, gesture math, committed viewport transform, and view-to-content transform policy.
Web must stop owning cumulative trackpad viewport scale and translation; it only normalizes browser events into common runtime navigation input.
Android and Windows remain thin consumers of common runtime interaction state.
C0 must not modify brush algorithms, Skia/render, Arc, semantic schema, or Dear ImGui.
